purpose: Separate the packed STORE FORMAT (unchanged) from the PROGRAM CHOICE (old two-step `encode` searches candidates; the new direct `field-build --profile runtime` fixes the runtime/RAW program). Run on two documents whose new store differs from the old 2978e1d store, using the CURRENT binary (954dbc2) with the OLD two-step commands.
method: target/release/vole-document encode SRC d/doc.voldoc; then field-ingest d/doc.voldoc --store d/pack --packed (identical to the phase16 storage-correction court's old path)

docs.note: current encode+ingest reproduces the OLD store BYTE-FOR-BYTE (same field id): the packed format is unchanged. The new field-build fixes RAW and stores a slightly larger field (65,901 vs 65,713).

the current search lands within 0.02% of the OLD store (8,683 B, a small program-set evolution between commits 2978e1d and 954dbc2), while the new fixed-RAW field is 7.5% larger. The dominant term is program choice, not format.

conclusion: The new direct path trades a small persistent-storage cost for skipping the candidate search: it stores the fixed runtime/RAW program, so its packed store is >= the old searched store on every common document (aggregate +5.3% on the 96 common docs). Where both paths pick the same program the stores are byte-identical (15/96, all epub).
